Central Works & Buildings Bureau 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Jharkhand · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/19/2012/133 
 Dated: 2026-03-31 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Community Centre - Jharkhand Pkg-133" (small buildings), awarded
 to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
 completed in all respects on 2012-03-25 at a gross executed value of INR 6,87,00,000/- (Rupees 6.87 Crore
 Only). 
 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
 workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Neha Chopra. This certificate is issued for record and
 for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance.
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Central Works & Buildings Bureau
